info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Directory Retrieval API allows users to access detailed product management information based on specific parameters. This endpoint provides essential data about products in the banking sector, making it valuable for developers and analysts who manage or utilize product listings. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial services platforms that require up-to-date product information for decision-making and user interaction. By using this API, organizations can seamlessly integrate product data into their systems.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of a specific product using its unique identifier (PROD-700045). This endpoint is essential for obtaining product specifications, availability, and other relevant data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information about the specific product identified by the PROD-700045 identifier. Ensure that the information provided is accurate to receive the correct product data.

GetProductManagementByParam1Request.description: A string representation of the request body for the product operations API.

baseCurrency.description: The currency in which the product's pricing is based.

effectiveDate.description: The date from which the product becomes effective.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the product record.

version.description: The version number of the product.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the product was last updated.
